page.overview:
Who is Snow's Final Fantasy XIII battle and field exploration quotes?

Snow is a playable character in Final Fantasy XIII who uses various lines in battle and field exploration, depending on actions taken and the point of the game the player is in.

Keep your claws off my Serah! —Second fight against Barthandelus.

He's not leaving us a choice... —Fight against The Proudclad.

So, this is Orphan. —First fight against Orphan's first form.
